page.layout: One page of running text, no margin notes. Running head at the top centre, page number at the top left. Paragraphs of citations and quotations follow one another in one column. A thesis "II." in italics stands as its own paragraph. A catchword with the section number "III." sits at the foot right.

main_text.l: A JAC. ARMINIO, Contra Perkinf. pag. 195. DEUS vult serio ut omnes homines salventur, at compulsus pertinaci & incorrigibili malitia nonnullorum, vult illos jacturam face-re salutis, hoc est, condemnari.
A SIM. EPISCOPIO, Disp. de vol. DEI, thes. 21. Ineptum & ridiculum est dicere seriam & veram voluntatem DEI esse ne-quire, nisi effectum fortiatur.
II. Per electionis decretum non intelligi propositum DEI, de certis aliquibus hominibus singularibus servandis, sed tantum de certo hominum genere servando, scilicet, fidelium perseverantium.

A WELSINGIO, De Offic. hom. Christ. fol. B. 3. Decretum Electionis communiter loquendo non ad certos ac definitos homines, nominatim hos vel illos, sed ad certum potius homi-num genus, sive ad homines generatim quidem acceptos, sed qualitate aliqua, hoc est, obedientia vel inobedientia praeditos, omnino referri debet.

A JAC. ARMINIO, Artic. perpend. pag. 21. Secundum decretum est, quo DEUS statuit resipiscentes & fideles in gratiam recipere, eosque perseverantes salvare in Christo, & per Christum. Illud secundum decretum est praedestinatio ad salutem.

A REMONSTRANTIBUS, Col. Hag. pag. 34. Nos aliam praedestinationem ad salutem in Evangelio revelatam non agnoscimus, quam quâ DEUS decrevit, credentes in Filium suum JESUM Christum, & in eadem fide perseverantes, salvos facere.

l.i: Ibidem. pag. 57. Perseverantes fideles velle salvos facere, totum est decretum Praedestinationis ad salutem.

main_text.l: A JOAN. ARNOLDO, contra Tilen. pag. 53. Decretum Electionis nihil aliud est, quam decretum, quo DEUS statuit, fideles in Christo justificare & salvare.
A NIC. GREVINCHOVIO, contra Amef. pag. iii[?]. Uniformia & conformia mihi sunt Electionis & justificationis de-creta.

page.notes: The word "potius" in the Welsingius citation carries a strike-through line, and "hominum" follows it. The printer's correction is kept as printed. In the Arminius citation "salvare in Christo" also shows a strike-through over "in". The page reference "pag. iii" to Grevinchovius is uncertain, since the numeral could also be "111". The catchword "III. Caussam" is a section number with the next word, printed at the foot right. Long s is transcribed as s throughout. Capital I before a vowel is transcribed as J (JAC., JOAN., JESUM, justificare), and V as a vowel as U (DEUS, REMONSTRANTIBUS).
